description: Which units are allowed to be typed where. ERPNext ships around a hundred UOMs and a farm uses nine of them, differently in each place: harvest is counted in bins, lugs and buckets, a spray tank is measured in gallons and fluid ounces, ground is measured in acres, and a unit that is right in one of those is nonsense in the others. WHAT THIS BUYS IS A REFUSAL WITH A LIST IN IT. Without it, a harvest record offered 'Fluid Ounce' has nothing to object with and stores it; with it, the refusal names the three units harvest actually uses. IT IS A CONTEXT AND NOT A DOCTYPE-PER-PLACE because the same list serves a tool, a mobile form and a Desk field, and three copies of 'what harvest is counted in' is how two of them go stale.

fields.description: What the context is called — 'Harvest', 'Spray', 'Field Area', 'Scale Ticket'. IT IS THE DOCNAME and it is the string a caller passes, so it is written the way somebody says the job rather than the way a table is named.
fields.label: Context

fields.description: Whether this context is in use. Switched off rather than deleted, for the same reason a Market is: records written under it name it, and validation that used to run against it should still be explicable a year later.
fields.label: Active

fields.description: The measurement this context is about, which is what makes two contexts comparable — Weight, Volume, Area, Count. NOT THE SAME QUESTION AS THE UNIT LIST BELOW: 'Harvest' and 'Scale Ticket' are two contexts with different allowed units that are both about Weight, and a conversion between their units is meaningful precisely because of that. A context whose rows span two dimensions is refused, because a list mixing gallons and acres is not a unit list, it is two.
fields.label: Measures

fields.description: What work this context covers, in a sentence — so an operator adding a unit to it can tell whether it belongs.
fields.label: Description

fields.description: The units this context accepts. AT MOST ONE MAY BE THE DEFAULT — two defaults is the same as none, and the parent refuses it — and no unit may appear twice. A context with no rows at all is refused on save: an empty allow-list either forbids everything or permits everything depending on which reader you ask, and both readings have been shipped by somebody.
fields.label: Valid Units
